name: Colonnade
desc: A hypostyle hall walked forever — a depth-sorted forest of fluted stone columns whose ranks slide across each other into fleeting alignments, architraves running overhead to the vanishing point, and a pool of clerestory light wandering the slabs ahead.

energy.doc: light amplitude, glow and camera bob

scale.doc: column height/girth + bay width vs frame (2.2 = colossal Karnak drums; Z pitch stays fixed so this is never a no-op)

density.doc: ranks of columns across and into depth (4x5 to 8x11)

speed.doc: rate the camera walks the hall

sway.doc: lateral wander and yaw of the walk — the parallax that makes the ranks slide

style.doc: aesthetic: modelled warm limestone / form from light alone on near-black / cyan schematic linework / hatched paper plate / saturated lapis temple

seed.doc: per-column weathering and drum joints (absolute-index keyed, which is what breaks the grid's translation symmetry)
